intro:
The Station (table 8, a round lounge on a space station above the Earth), seat 1 (far left), drawn facing the viewer's right. Built the way the Transylvania cast is (`art-tools/pose_rig.py`, a short `rig_spec.json`), in the same graphic-novel style: the Headless Horseman's approved sheet is the style image, lit by the station (a cool blue Earthlight rim light and warm lamps) instead of candles.

Its look, from its character file: the visitor of modern folklore, owned by nobody: an upturned teardrop of a head on a thin neck, huge black almond eyes, a mouth that never moves, long thin fingers. Built from the archetype: nothing from the 1987 Communion cover, Close Encounters, any television series or any real person's account.

Tags (MOTION-SPEC.md): its three tells, each beside an idle that moves the same part: blinking sideways (strong, a pale membrane across the eyes) beside staring at the backs of your cards (the eyes); its head tilting forty degrees (bluffing) beside watching someone breathe (the head); its long fingers splaying (weak) beside touching the table as if it had never seen wood (the fingers). Humming is C4. Its mouth never moves, so it talks with a faint glow in its eyes (the face sheet). B3 and D4 are the big win and the crushing loss; its hands are empty in every pose.

character:
Character sheet for 2D animation rigging: the Grey, the visitor of modern folklore (small, grey, large-headed, with great black eyes), built from the archetype, which belongs to nobody. Copy ONLY the LAYOUT of the FIRST attached sheet (what goes where): take NOTHING of its character. No plate armour, no striped surcoat, no long hair, no human face. Take the STYLE from the SECOND and THIRD attached images.

The Grey: a slight, slender figure with a HUGE smooth hairless head shaped like an upturned teardrop, wide across the top and narrowing to a small pointed chin, on a thin neck and narrow, sloping shoulders. Enormous glossy black almond-shaped eyes slanting up at the outer corners, with no whites and no pupils, only a soft highlight. Two tiny slits for a nose. A small, straight, lipless mouth that never moves. Smooth, faintly luminous grey skin, a little paler on the face. Thin arms and long, thin grey fingers, four to a hand, with no nails. It wears nothing and carries nothing; its body is smooth and plain, without detail. Calm, curious and utterly unreadable: it studies the card table as if poker were a specimen. Not cute, not a cartoon alien, not green, no antennae. Nothing from any film, television series or book cover.

Pure white background (#FFFFFF). Every piece separate, with a closed dark outline and a wide gap all round it; nothing touches or overlaps. No text, no labels, no frames, no cast shadows.

The angle: a gentle three-quarter view, turned about 25 degrees from front-on, facing the viewer's right. Both eyes, the face and both shoulders clearly visible. NOT profile.

Draw, all facing the viewer's right, at the same size:
- Finished heads, each with the thin neck and the top of the shoulders: neutral, eyes open; a thin pale membrane sliding sideways across both eyes; the head tilted far over to one side; the head lowered a little, watching
- The torso: no head, thin, smooth and grey, cut off straight below the waist, the upper arms down to the elbows; NO forearms, NO hands
- Two thin grey forearms with long-fingered hands lying on a table, pointing toward its centre, open at the elbow end
- Four seated reference poses, waist up behind the curved edge of a round green poker table, forearms resting on its edge, hands apart: neutral; the membrane sliding sideways across its eyes; its head tilted far over; its long fingers splayed wide on the felt

A: At rest: both thin forearms lying along the table's edge, its long grey fingers resting on the felt in front of it, a hand's width apart, relaxed and NOT touching, NOT laced, NOT overlapping; its head level, its black eyes on the table
Peeking at its cards: its right hand cupped low over the felt in front of it, the long fingers curled as if shielding something small; its head tipped down
Checking: one long finger of its right hand tapping the felt
Calling: its right hand flat, fingertips leading, pushing forward along the felt
Betting: leaning in, its right hand pushed well forward along the felt, unhurried
Folding: its right hand lifting from the felt and turning palm up, the long fingers opening, letting something go
B: All in: both hands pushing forward along the felt together, its head lowered, intent
Showing: its right hand turning palm up from the felt, as if turning something over
A big win: both thin arms raised and spread wide, the long fingers spread, its head tipped back a little; its face does not change at all
Blinking SIDEWAYS: a thin, pale, half-clear membrane sliding sideways across both black eyes, from the outer corners in; the rest of it perfectly still, arms as at rest
Staring at the viewer's cards: its head tipped a little forward and toward the viewer, its eyes fixed low, perfectly still; arms as at rest
The long fingers of both hands splayed wide and flat on the felt, stretched as far apart as they go
C: Touching the table as if it had never seen wood: one long fingertip of its right hand stroking the wooden rim of the table, its head bent close to look at it; left arm as at rest
Its whole head tilted far over toward its left shoulder, about forty degrees, still looking at the middle of the table; arms as at rest
Watching someone breathe, with interest: its head turned toward the right of the picture and tipped a little, as if studying someone's chest rise and fall; arms as at rest
Humming: faint, fine vibration lines round its head and throat, its mouth closed; arms as at rest
Turning its head and shoulders toward the viewer, its huge black eyes on the viewer; arms as at rest
Lifting its right hand and studying its own long fingers, turning them slowly in front of its eyes, as if it had never noticed them before; left arm as at rest
D: Talking without moving its mouth: its right hand raised a little, palm open, the long fingers loose, a faint soft glow deep in its black eyes
Facing a big bet: sitting very still and upright, its head drawn back a little, both hands flat on the felt
Lost a pot: its head tilting slowly to one side, as if puzzled, studying the middle of the table; arms as at rest
A crushing loss: both long hands spread over the top of its huge head, its head bowed low toward the table
Down to two players: leaning in on both forearms, its head lowered toward the viewer, eyes fixed on the viewer
A slow, deep nod, its head dipped forward, both hands flat on the felt

style: STYLE, the most important rule: match the SECOND and THIRD attached images (the Headless Horseman and Count Dracula, from an earlier table) exactly: the same inked GOTHIC GRAPHIC-NOVEL style, halfway between a bright cartoon and a dark painted illustration. Take NOTHING of their characters: no armour, no pumpkin, no cape, no vampire. What makes that style, and this drawing must have all of it: a thick, dark, inked outline of even weight round every shape; flat cel shading in three or four HARD-EDGED tones, the shadows deep and dark and covering a good part of each form; a little rough, dry-brush texture inside the shadows only; muted, slightly dirty colour, never clean or glossy. NO airbrush, NO soft gradients, NO smooth 3D rendering, NO glossy plastic or wet-looking highlights, NO fine anatomical detail. Big clear readable shapes and a silhouette that reads at a tiny size; grown-up proportions, never chibi, never cute. The light is the space station's: a cool blue rim light from the Earth in a great window on one side, soft warm lamplight on the other, both laid in as flat bands of colour. Quiet, strange and a little lonely. NOT a children's cartoon, NOT toy-like, NOT photoreal, NOT a 3D render, NOT glossy chrome sci-fi.
